About us: Docsumo is Document AI software that helps enterprises automate document processing. We help enterprises convert documents such as invoices, ID cards & bank statements into actionable data. We are backed by Sequoia, Barclays, Techstars & Better Capital. Responsibilities: This is an AE (Account Executive) track role.

As Sales/ Business Development Representative you will be working closely with management to identify new opportunities, reach out to potential customers via email and LinkedIn, conduct discovery and demo calls. Work with the marketing team to create and execute sales campaigns.

Develop sales opportunities by researching and identifying potential accounts. Prepare and deliver presentations/demos and connect in a professional way to USA tech buyers. Rolling out weekly newsletters, email and drip campaigns. Making outbound calls to drive monthly & quarterly sales targets.

Assess competitors by analyzing and summarizing competitor information and trends. Handling all incoming customer queries on our live chat. Get customer feedback to generate ideas about new features or products.

Meet quarterly goals & sales target Requirements: Must have 2-4 years of industry experience into selling IT/SaaS products and concepts Should have prior experience working with "C" & "D" level executives Excited to sell brand-new technology products Proficient in English & Sensitive of US culture Consistent track record of documenting, synthesizing, and communicating results Team player who can take responsibility for anything from fixing the office internet to making a sales pitch to the CEO of a company.

We believe in the ideology that - Buck stops with me Must be self-motivated, flexible, collaborative, with an eagerness to learn Originally posted on Himalayas

Candidates must be located within a reasonable commuting distance (approximately one hour) of a major or semi-major airport in the U.S. About Teton Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care- using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the resident and care environment.

Our proprietary computer vision system enables staff to automate documentation, proactively manage resident acuity, and streamline workflows across entire facilities.

From assisted living communities to hospital wards, our system delivers unprecedented access to real-time data insights, empowering providers with actionable intelligence to enhance decision-making and elevate care delivery.

With strong demand and a clear product-market fit, this role represents our fourth strategic sales hire in the U.S., focused on scaling our presence across the East Coast. It's a rare opportunity to drive market expansion and define how we win in one of our highest-potential regions.

Role Overview We’re looking for a Business Development Representative to help drive our U.S. growth. This position is heavily focused on outbound prospecting, with an emphasis on opening doors and building relationships at the executive and C-suite level in the senior living industry.

Candidates will need to bring both persistence and sophistication to their outreach- balancing high activity with thoughtful engagement of senior decision-makers.

This role offers direct exposure to enterprise sales cycles and close collaboration with leadership, making it an excellent opportunity for someone looking to advance their career in strategic business development. What You’ll Do Master Teton ’s platform, our commercial approach, and the senior living industry landscape.

Drive a high-volume outbound prospecting model (LinkedIn, email, and phone), using strategic, AI-driven methods to reach and engage senior executives and C-suites in senior living. Build and manage early-stage relationships with C-suite and executive stakeholders, preparing the ground for the Business Development Director.

Prepare outreach plans, activity schedules, and tailored messaging to meet pipeline targets. Support conferences and industry events by helping to set meetings and manage executive-level follow-up. Track activity, pipeline progress, and outreach performance in the CRM with attention to detail.

Stay current on competitors, industry trends, and market dynamics to sharpen prospecting strategy. Contribute to team projects and GTM initiatives as assigned. Always tie your work to Teton ’s mission of empowering caregivers and improving the quality of life for residents in senior living.

What You’ll Need 1–3 years of experience in business development, sales development, or a related outbound role, with a strong track record of achieving growth targets. Proven ability to engage and hold conversations with senior executives and C-suites Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

A self-starter mentality with excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Comfortable with high-volume outbound prospecting while also contributing strategically to pipeline generation. Thrives in a high-activity sales environment with significant daily call volume.

Passionate about building a career in sales while making a meaningful impact in healthcare- helping caregivers work more efficiently and improving quality of life for residents in senior living communities. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Must have a valid driver’s license.

Candidates must reside in the U.S. and be within commuting distance to a major/semi-major airport. Why Join Teton Be part of a company transforming senior living care with cutting-edge technology. Gain direct exposure to enterprise deal cycles and executive-level sales strategy.

Clear growth path into senior business development and sales roles, including ownership of multi-stakeholder opportunities. Opportunity to make a measurable impact at an early stage in Teton ’s U.S. expansion. What It’s Like Working at Teton We’re a growing team of extremely hard-working and talented people.

The learning curves are steep, and expanding your skill set is not just encouraged- it’s expected. It’s a hands-on environment where you’ll be challenged, supported, and constantly learning. We are looking for people who believe in our long-term vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship rather than just another 9-5 job.

With us you will have an opportunity to truly make an impact on the world with the outcomes of your work. So, if you are looking for a ride and not just a job- jump on board 😊 Originally posted on Himalayas

We are the platform turning browsing into shopping . We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.
We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.
In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company Flipp, creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.
Ready to spark your growth with us?
Wen wir suchen 🦄 Als Digital Sales Consultant - Germany (w/m/d/x) bei Shopfully spielst du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau und der Pflege von Beziehungen zum deutschen Retail und wichtigen Werbepartnern am deutschen Markt.

Du arbeitest strategisch daran, unsere digitalen Werbelösungen zu positionieren und sicherzustellen, dass Marken und Händler ihre Drive-to-Store-Strategien maximal ausschöpfen. In deiner Rolle kombinierst du proaktiven Sales und Account Management, um neue Partnerschaften aufzubauen und bestehende auszubauen. Deine mission 🏄
Proaktive Beratung von Handels- und Retail-Partnern zur optimalen Nutzung unserer Werbelösungen.
Entwicklung und Umsetzung maßgeschneiderter Kundenstrategien mit klaren KPIs, die direkt auf die Umsatzziele der Kunden einzahlen.
Identifikation neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im Handelsumfeld, sowie gezieltes Upselling und Cross-Selling zur Maximierung des Umsatzwachstums mit Marken und Retail-Kunden.
Management einer Opportunity-Pipeline inklusive präziser Berichte und Forecasts für das Management.
Proaktive Neukundenakquise und strategischer Outreach im Retail-Sektor zur Gewinnung neuer Handelspartner durch Kaltakquise, Networking und gezielte Ansprache.
Betreuung, strategische Weiterentwicklung und langfristige Bindung von Bestandskunden.
Das bringst du mit 🪄
Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, Account Management, idealerweise im Digital Advertising oder Ad-Tech.
Idealerweise 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung.
Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten im Beziehungsaufbau, in der Verhandlung und im Stakeholder-Management, auch auf C-Level.
Starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten für die effiziente Beratung und Betreuung von Kund:innen sowie Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams.
Selbstständige und Eigeninitiative Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Accounts und Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu managen.
Ausgeprägtes analytisches und datengetriebenes Mindset zur Ableitung von strategischen Insights.
Erfahrung oder großes Interesse in der strategischen Weiterentwicklung von Kundenbeziehungen.
Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau und fließendes Englisch.
👉 In unserem Unternehmen schätzen wir Vielfalt und fördern sie aktiv – wir sind überzeugt, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Hintergründe uns stärker machen. Wir legen den Fokus auf Potenzial statt auf einen „perfekten“ Lebenslauf.

Wenn dich diese Rolle begeistert und du glaubst, dass du in ihr wachsen kannst – auch wenn du nicht jede einzelne Anforderung erfüllst – freuen wir uns sehr, von dir zu hören! LOCATION 🌐 Unser Büros befinden sich in Berlin & Dresden. Dank unseres flexiblen Hybridmodells (auch 100% remote möglich) kannst du dort arbeiten, wo du am produktivsten bist.

Darauf kannst du dich bei Shopfully freuen 🤗 🌎 Eine spannende Möglichkeit, in einem internationalen, schnell wachsenden Unternehmen mitzuwirken 🕶️ Ein offenes, lebendiges und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld 🧠 Viel Raum für Eigenverantwortung, Flexibilität und die Vorteile eines hybriden Arbeitsmodells 📚 Kontinuierliche Entwicklung durch Lernangebote und regelmäßiges Feedback 🍓 Ein modernes, zentral gelegenes Büro mit frischen Snacks, Kaffee und ergonomischer Ausstattung 🎉 Gemeinsame Erlebnisse, die verbinden: Offsites, After-Work-Drinks, Firmenfeiern und Teamevents 💻 Die passende Ausstattung, damit du überall produktiv arbeiten und dir deinen Arbeitsplatz optimal einrichten kannst 🧰 Zusätzliche standortspezifische Benefits entsprechend deinem lokalen Vertrag (Empfehlungsprogramm, Shopping-Rabatte etc.) WHO WE ARE 💜 We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities.

We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us. TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ I N SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯
Progress Over Perfection : We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.
Clarity Through Transparency : We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better.
Learn Loudly : We grow by doing and by daring. Big bets unlock big breakthroughs. But real innovation demands risk, and risk always carries the possibility of failure. That’s not a flaw. It’s the price of ambition.
Challenge with Empathy : We speak up, even when it’s hard—because candor shows care, and leads to better outcomes. Listening deeply is how we grow. Disagreeing openly is how we build trust. Always Build Better: We are builders—of products, systems, and ideas. But more than that, we are builders of better. Better has no finish line. It’s a mindset.

If you choose to apply for this specific job position and submit your application, which may include personal data such as your identifying details, contact information, curriculum vitae, cover letter, professional qualifications, and/or employment history, please be informed that your data may be shared with our Affiliates*, including Offerista Group GmbH and Flipp Operations Inc.

The aforementioned entities will act as joint controllers for the limited purpose of intra-group sharing related to the evaluation of candidates’ applications. This means that your data may be processed by the Affiliate to assess your application and, if deemed suitable, to contact you regarding potential employment opportunities.

However, please note that from the moment an Affiliate initiates direct contact with you and engages in any further processing of your personal data beyond the initial intra-group sharing for evaluation purposes, such Affiliate shall act as an independent data controller.

In such cases, the processing of your personal data will be subject to the specific privacy policies that can be found here. * Affiliates shall mean any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by or is under common control with ShopFully SpA and its Affiliates’ subsidiaries, meaning any entity which is directly or indirectly controlled by the Affiliates.

At SiteMinder we believe the individual contributions of our employees are what drive our success. That’s why we hire and encourage diverse teams that include and respect a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!
What We Do…
We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online - quickly and simply.
We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.
And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 50,000 hotels in 150+ countries - with over 130 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.
About the Senior Sales Executive role...
Are you ready to take the next step in your SaaS Sales career? Do you want to be part of the technology shaping the future of the travel industry? Join our international, dynamic and outgoing team in Barcelona!
You will become a trusted advisor to hotel owners, building awareness about how our products can benefit their property. You will have the chance to learn about the challenges that accommodation providers face, and offer a solution that will bring value to their day-to-day and bottom line. Joining SiteMinder as the leader in dynamic hotel revenue management, you will be at the forefront of innovation in the sector.
We won't throw you into the deep end - you'll be trained on our products, industry and sales processes. We have a month-long sales training and onboarding program to make sure you are set up for success. You will be supported by a dedicated sales coach and a buddy, as well as your team leader, who will coach and motivate you to achieve your professional goals.
We know that an attractive compensation package is a key motivator in sales. SiteMinder offers you not only this, but also a working environment that represents ambition, collaboration, self-development and customer-centricity. If you identify with our core values (We Hustle, We Come Together, We Grow, We Make Things Simple) and you are a sales hunter at heart, we want to hear from you!

Client acquisition - Create new opportunities and upsell current customers. You will be responsible for the full sales cycle, from outreach to demo and closing.
Achieving sales KPIs and targets - Working towards daily, weekly and monthly targets and finalize all sales in a timely manner.
Presentation and negotiation – Prepare accurate quotes and develop and present proposals to clients in a professional and confident manner. Negotiate contracts as required, maintaining a balance between optimal service and value for the client and SiteMinder's profit margins.
CRM maintenance – Maintain accurate records of your business development activities on SiteMinder's CRM system.
Client feedback – Provide client feedback on products to the Product Team so that products can be reviewed in line with the feedback.
Partner management – Work with local industry groups and travel associations to promote SiteMinder’s products and brand. Attend key functions and events, requiring occasional travel to client locations to attend meetings with relevant managers.
What you have...
Experience in Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) sales
Fluent in German (min. C2)
Professional proficiency in English
A confident phone presence, fearlessness in leading meetings with prospects, and great listening skills
Strong communication skills professionally with customers, in writing and over the phone
Self-motivation and resilience to show up each day and give your best
Growth mindset - openness to feedback and coaching
Please send us your CV in English!

Remote setup
Equity packages for you to share in SiteMinder's growth and successes
Investment in your personal growth
Uncapped commission that rewards overachievement
Excellence-driven, collaborative culture
Well-being initiatives
Referral bonus for bringing in new talent
Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy
Paid birthday, study and volunteering days off every year
Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved

High-quality fresh chocolate - that's what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business now employs over 2500 people from more than 80 countries across the group, and the trend is rising. The company's headquarters are located in the canton of Glarus. Here, against a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates and are constantly developing new, innovative ideas in agile teams.
The Retail business unit comprises more than 250 chocolateries in more than 30 countries. Here we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate in ever new ways. Want to be part of it too? Come and join us.
##### What you can expect #####
* You provide customer-oriented advice and sell our wide range of products, for example when helping customers choose gifts
* You actively engage with our customers, identify their needs, and offer suitable solutions
* You handle checkout processes and ensure accurate and correct cash management
* You present our exquisite confectionery and chocolate assortment in an appealing and inviting way
* You also perform production-related tasks as well as restocking and maintaining the sales areas
* You implement our high quality standards with dedication and care
* You consistently ensure compliance with hygiene and freshness standards
* You work hand in hand with your team and contribute to a positive working atmosphere
##### What we expect from you #####
* You bring valuable professional experience in retail and have a passion for sales as well as a strong focus on closing deals
* You enjoy direct contact with customers and aim to provide them with a special shopping experience
* You quickly identify customer needs and provide tailored, friendly, and convincing advice
* You have excellent communication skills and express yourself clearly and confidently
* You speak German and English very well; French and other languages are a strong advantage and highly valued
* You consistently prioritize quality and customer focus, even in busy or high-pressure situations
* You work in a responsible, reliable, and well-structured manner
* You have a strong awareness of quality and consistently maintain hygiene and cleanliness standards
* You are happy to take responsibility, are a true team player, and are committed to shared goals
* You are motivated to further develop your skills in sales and service
* You are flexible and not hesitant to work on weekends, Saturdays, Sundays, or public holidays

About Atira
Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. CRM. Atira. ERP.
We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!
Why this role compounds
Sales is the one skill that compounds across every career path. Whether you become a founder, a closer, or a senior commercial leader, the people who got there learned the craft early. Atira is where you learn it right.
You will be one of the first persons we hire in our GTM team. This means you will define how Atira finds, qualifies, and engages customers across our key verticals. This role goes well beyond what you would do at any other early stage startup looking for BDRs right now. We are looking for someone who is up for a real challenge in a fast moving environment and in return can become an Account Executive at Atira within the next 8-12 months.

s.h: How the role sits in the team
s.t: As Atira scales, we build industry-specific "pods" at the heart of our GTM approach: Forward Deployed Engineer, Account Executive, BDR, Product Marketer, and a GTM Engineer. The BDR sits at the front of the pod, working hand-in-hand with the GTM Engineer and AE to bring success stories from existing customers to new ones. The story flywheel starts with you.

We have some of the highest profile enterprise customers and are building the story around them. In parallel our team is growing fast to meet the inbound demand we are currently getting across customer segments and sizes.
We are now heavily scaling our GTM Team and are looking for founding team members to re-define how industrials sell complex products.

Building the outbound engine. You design the sequences, test the channels (phone, email, LinkedIn, events), and figure out what works even better at industrial customers. The global playbook starts now, you help write it
Work closely with our Forward Deployed Engineering Teams. You will be the story teller of our deep and impactful Enterprise engagements. No mass blasts. We are working with the industry leaders in each sub vertical. You will know more about a customer's sales & engineering process than most of their own sales engineers before the first meeting.
Customer outreach. You will speak with industrial leaders & Sales Engineers across different industrial verticals and be a key person within the initial sales process together with founders and Account executives.
Become AI-native in your craft. You proactively identify where AI accelerates outbound work, you experiment with new approaches, and you share what works with the rest of the team
Feed learnings back into product and marketing. What objection comes up in 70% of cold calls? Which ICP segment responds best to which message? You are the ground truth on what the market actually says, and that signal flows back to our founders, the AE, and the product team

Hunger, structure, and the kind of resilience that does not wilt after seven dial-tones in a row. Problem-solving, creativity, and drive matter more than the right number of years on your CV. We have hired strong people from non-traditional backgrounds before. We will confidently do it again.
That said, the following references give a guideline of what we typically see in strong candidates.
Your profile
You are motivated to build something from the ground up. You take ownership of work others would delegate and finish what you start
Fluent in German and English
Ideally, concrete evidence of hitting outbound targets in a prior role. If you don't have prior experience, you compensate with a serious side hustle, sales-heavy student initiative, or another track record of convincing people to do hard things
AI-native outbound: you have built your own research and personalisation stack and know how to scale personalisation without it becoming spam
Genuine curiosity about manufacturing and industrials. You don't need to know what a defense or aerospace RFQ involves on day one, but you need to be the kind of person who will know in week three. Ideally, you have already looked it up by reading this

Close collaboration with our co-founder Florian (ex-Palantir DACH commercial lead). You iterate the playbook with him, benefitting from his experience
Validated traction. Leading Industrial customers including several with revenues above €1B within a clearly defined ICP. You are not hunting in the dark
Clear AE pathway. Strong BDRs move into an AE seat within 12-18 months. For this strategic hire we have a fast track
AI-native sales stack. Attio, Apollo, plus whatever else helps you close. We get you the tools you need
Competitive base equity package, uncapped variable. OTE designed so over-performance is real money, not symbolic
Central Munich office. Vibrant in-office culture additional benefits including Wellpass, JobRad and dinners
Most importantly: Collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function but will do so with modesty and integrity

You have co-built the first version of the outbound playbook: named sequences per ICP segment, tested openers, working objection handlers

Vertriebs-Mindset und Kommunikations-Talent?Wir glauben nicht an stumpfes „Cold Calling“ nach Schema F. Denn die Realität im modernen B2B-Vertrieb ist: Jeder Mensch kommuniziert anders.

Der eine HR-Entscheider greift am liebsten direkt zum Hörer, die nächste filtert ihre Prioritäten morgens per E-Mail, und wieder jemand anderes ist am besten über eine gezielte Nachricht auf LinkedIn erreichbar. Deine Kunst liegt darin, für die richtige Person den genau passenden Kanal zu wählen, echtes Interesse zu wecken und die Brücke zu bauen.
Deine Aufgaben
Identifikation und Marktanalyse: Du recherchierst eigenständig nach potenziellen Neukunden (B2B) und identifizierst die relevanten HR-Entscheider und Geschäftsführer in verschiedenen Zielmärkten. Du analysierst Branchen-Trends, um deine Ansprache maßzuschneidern.

Erstkontakt und Lead-Qualifizierung: Du sprichst potenzielle Kunden proaktiv über verschiedene Kanäle (Telefon, E-Mail, LinkedIn/Social Selling) an. Mit den richtigen Fragen findest du im Erstgespräch heraus, wo der Schuh drückt, und qualifizierst die Leads hinsichtlich ihres Bedarfs und Potenzials.
Beziehungsaufbau und Terminierung: Du begeisterst HR-Verantwortliche von unserer innovativen HR-Software und vereinbarst qualifizierte Demo-Termine für unsere Account Executives. Du bist die „Visitenkarte“ von HRpuls und baust die erste vertrauensvolle Brücke zu unseren Kunden.
Pipeline-Management und Optimierung: Du pflegst unser CRM-System gewissenhaft und hältst deine Sales-Pipeline stets aktuell. Du optimierst deine Ansprache-Strategien kontinuierlich im Team, um die Effizienz und Conversion-Rate zu steigern.
Welche Qualifikation benötigst Du?
Vertriebsaffinität: Erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, Telesales, Account Management oder der Kundenbetreuung – idealerweise im B2B- oder SaaS-Umfeld – ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Quereinsteiger mit der richtigen Einstellung sind herzlich willkommen!
Kommunikationsstärke: Du hast eine positive Ausstrahlung am Telefon, bist redegewandt, kannst aktiv zuhören und lässt dich von einem „Nein“ nicht entmutigen.
Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du organisierst deine Aufgaben und Leads selbstständig, arbeitest zielorientiert und behältst im CRM stets den Überblick.
Technische Affinität: Erfahrung mit modernen Software-Tools (z. B. Office, CRM-Systeme, SaaS) und ein Interesse an HR- und Softwarelösungen.
Lernbereitschaft: Du hast Lust, dich fachlich und methodisch im Tech-Vertrieb weiterzuentwickeln, und möchtest ein echter Experte in der Neukundenansprache werden.
Warum HRpuls?
Wachstum & Entwicklung: Unser kontinuierliches Wachstum bietet Dir die beste Grundlage für Deine persönliche, methodische und fachliche Entwicklung.
Weiterentwicklung: Bei uns hast Du die Chance, Deine Karriere aktiv zu gestalten.
Kreativer Freiraum: Wir lieben frische Ideen und setzen sie schnell um. Du wirst Teil eines Teams sein, das Innovation schätzt und ermutigt, Neues auszuprobieren. Fehler sind für uns kein Problem, sondern die Grundlage für Verbesserungen.
Team & Werte: Unser Team ist bunt und vielfältig, aber uns verbinden gemeinsame Werte, die auf unserer Website zu finden sind. Bei uns wirst Du Dich schnell als Teil einer starken Gemeinschaft fühlen.
Flexibel und ortsunabhängig: Als Remote-First-Unternehmen kannst Du vollständig ortsunabhängig arbeiten. Workations sind bei uns Standard. So gestaltest Du Deinen Arbeitsalltag flexibel, während Du gleichzeitig Teil unseres dynamischen Teams bleibst.

**Work Pattern:** 80% - 100%
**Help organisations stay one step ahead of cyber threats **
Cyber attacks are no longer a question of if, but when. While prevention remains important, organisations increasingly rely on their ability to detect threats early, respond effectively, and recover quickly.
At Deloitte, we help some of Switzerland's largest and most critical organisations build and transform their cyber defence capabilities. From designing Cyber Defence Centres and Security Operations Centres to improving incident response, deploying security technologies, and exploring AI-enabled security operations, we help our clients strengthen their resilience against an ever-evolving threat landscape.
If you are passionate about cyber defence, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology, this is the opportunity for you.
**How you can make an impact **
As a Cyber Detect & Respond Advisor, you will work alongside experienced cyber professionals to help clients prepare for, detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats and attacks.

* Assess and improve cyber defence capabilities, including Security Operations Centres (SOC), Cyber Defence Centres (CDC), Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, and Vulnerability Management
* Help clients design practical and effective cyber defence strategies, operating models, governance structures, and transformation roadmaps
* Design, implement, configure, and optimise cyber defence technologies such as SIEM, EDR, NDR, Threat Intelligence, and Vulnerability Management platforms
* Support the development of detection use cases, monitoring capabilities, automation workflows, and security operations processes
* Conduct cyber defence assessments, maturity reviews, and benchmarking exercises to identify improvement opportunities
* Support incident response readiness activities, including playbook development, tabletop exercises, and crisis preparedness initiatives
* Evaluate emerging technologies and help clients understand how innovations such as AI-powered security operations can enhance detection and response capabilities
* Work closely with specialists across Deloitte to deliver integrated cyber security solutions that create measurable value for clients
* Contribute to business development, thought leadership, and the continued growth of Deloitte's Detect & Respond practice

We are looking for curious and motivated professionals who combine technical expertise with a desire to make a real impact. You bring:
* Approximately 5+ years of professional experience in cyber security, cyber defence, security operations, incident response, threat intelligence, cyber engineering, or a related field
* A passion for helping organisations prepare for and respond to cyber threats
* Practical experience in one or more areas such as Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, Vulnerability Management, Digital Forensics, or Cyber Defence
* Familiarity with technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, XSIAM, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, EDR, NDR, SIEM, or similar solutions
* Understanding of modern threat actors, attack techniques, and cyber defence best practices
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders
* Curiosity, drive, and a desire to continuously learn and develop

* Experience working in a Security Operations Centre (SOC), Cyber Defence Centre (CDC), CSIRT, or Incident Response team
* Exposure to AI-enabled security operations, security automation, detection engineering, or threat validation
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, SC-200, AZ-500, or equivalent
* University degree in a relevant field (Bachelor's or Master's)
* Fluent English; German and/or French are an advantage
**Your team**
You will join a diverse, international, and highly collaborative team of cyber security professionals who are passionate about helping organisations strengthen their resilience against cyber threats.
What makes our team different is the opportunity to work across the full cyber defence lifecycle. One day you may be helping a client define their future Cyber Defence Centre strategy, the next designing security monitoring capabilities, improving incident response processes, or supporting the implementation of leading security technologies.
We believe that great careers are built through challenging work, continuous learning, and strong support. You will benefit from hands-on experience, dedicated mentoring, professional certifications, and collaboration with experts across Deloitte's global network.
Most importantly, we foster an open and inclusive culture where people are encouraged to bring new ideas, challenge the status quo, and shape the future of cyber defence.
Ready to make an impact?
Join us and help organisations build the capabilities they need to detect threats faster, respond smarter, and emerge stronger from cyber incidents. Your next challenge starts here.
**Careers at Deloitte. **
Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects.

At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation.

With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing.

You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn.
Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers.

============
**Verkaufsberater/in im Aussendienst 100 % – Quereinsteiger willkommen**
**Volmera GmbH \| Zentralschweiz**
**Deine Energie. Dein Einsatz. Deine Chance.**
Du gehst gerne auf Menschen zu, willst Verantwortung übernehmen und durch deinen persönlichen Einsatz etwas erreichen? Bei Volmera kannst du dir eine Zukunft im Verkauf aufbauen – mit einer fundierten Einarbeitung, persönlichem Coaching und einem Einkommen, das du durch deine Leistung mitgestaltest.
Wir suchen Menschen mit Persönlichkeit, Eigeninitiative und dem , dazuzulernen. Ob du bereits Verkaufserfahrung mitbringst oder aus der Gastronomie, dem Detailhandel, dem Handwerk oder einer anderen Branche kommst: **Deine Einstellung und dein Einsatz zählen.**
**Wer wir sind**
Die Volmera GmbH ist offizielerFranchisepartner von EET\-Schweiz. Wir beraten Privatkundinnen und Privatkunden zu Plug\-in\-Solarsystemen und kleinen Photovoltaikanlagen bewusst für den Eigenbedarf. Dabei zeigen wir verständlich und individuell auf, wie sie eigenen Solarstrom produzieren und ihre Stromkosten reduzieren können.
Unser Einsatzgebiet umfasst Luzern, Schwyz, Nidwalden, Obwalden, Uri und Glarus. Wir bauen unser Team aus und suchen Mitarbeitende, die diese Entwicklung langfristig mitgestalten möchten.
**Das bewegst du bei uns**
Du gewinnst neue Kundinnen und Kunden durch persönliche Ansprache im Aussendienst. **Door\-to\-Door ist ein fester Bestandteil deiner Arbeit:** Du gehst aktiv auf Menschen zu, weckst Interesse und vereinbarst Beratungstermine.

* **Neukunden gewinnen:** Du stellst Volmera / EET \- Schweiz persönlich vor, eröffnest Gespräche und vereinbarst Termine.
* **Bedürfnisse verstehen:** Du hörst zu, stellst gezielte Fragen und klärst, welche Solarlösung zur jeweiligen Situation passt.
* **Lösungen präsentieren:** Du erklärst unsere Produkte, deren Nutzen und die wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen verständlich.
* **Verkaufsgespräche führen:** Du beantwortest Fragen, gehst auf Einwände ein und führst Interessierte zu einer klaren Kaufentscheidung.
* **Kunden bis zum Abschluss begleiten:** Du hältst Vereinbarungen fest und sorgst für eine vollständige Übergabe der Aufträge.
* **Dich weiterentwickeln:** Du nimmst aktiv an Schulungen, Verkaufstrainings und Teamsitzungen teil und setzt das Gelernte im Alltag um.
Du bist viel unterwegs und arbeitest selbstständig. Gleichzeitig bleibst du im Austausch mit deinem Team und erhältst Unterstützung bei deiner Entwicklung.
**Das bringst du mit**
**Du brauchst keine abgeschlossene Verkaufsausbildung.** Du brauchst Freude am Kundenkontakt, Verbindlichkeit und die Bereitschaft, aktiv auf Menschen zuzugehen.

* Eine offene Persönlichkeit und Freude an persönlichen Gesprächen.
* Eigeninitiative und die Fähigkeit, deinen Arbeitstag zuverlässig zu organisieren.
* Ausdauer: Auch nach einer Absage bleibst du respektvoll, motiviert und handlungsfähig.
* Lernbereitschaft und Offenheit für ehrliches Feedback.
* Eine klare, verständliche Ausdrucksweise auf Deutsch.
* Ein gepflegtes Auftreten und einen wertschätzenden Umgang mit Kundschaft und Team.
* Einen **Führerausweis Kategorie B und ein eigenes Auto** für den Aussendienst.
* Die Bereitschaft, **100 % zu arbeiten und langfristig mit uns zu wachsen**.
Erfahrung im Verkauf, Service oder in der Kundenberatung ist willkommen. Als motivierte Quereinsteigerin oder motivierter Quereinsteiger erhältst du ebenfalls die Möglichkeit, dich bei uns zu beweisen.
**Das bieten wir dir**
**Fixlohn und leistungsabhängiger Bonus mit Open End.**
Du erhältst einen **monatlichen Fixlohn von CHF 3’500\.– brutto bei 100 %**, ergänzt durch einen leistungsabhängigen Bonus. Damit hast du eine feste Grundlage und kannst dein Einkommen durch erfolgreiche Arbeit erhöhen.
**Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung**
Du lernst unsere Produkte, die Kundenansprache und den Ablauf der Beratung Schritt für Schritt kennen. Gesprächsleitfäden, praktische Begleitung und regelmässige Trainings unterstützen deinen Einstieg.
**Persönliches Coaching**
Wir besprechen mit dir, was bereits gelingt und wo du weiterkommen kannst. Du erhältst konkrete Rückmeldungen und Unterstützung für deine nächsten Entwicklungsschritte.
**Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum**
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Termine, deine Kundenkontakte und deine Ergebnisse. Dein Einsatz macht einen sichtbaren Unterschied.
**Entwicklung mit Perspektive**
Mit wachsender Erfahrung und überzeugender Leistung kannst du zusätzliche Verantwortung übernehmen und dich im Verkauf weiterentwickeln.
**Ein Team, das gemeinsam vorankommt**
Dich erwarten direkter Austausch, gemeinsame Trainings und klare Ziele. Wir legen Wert auf Zuverlässigkeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung und Qualität in der Beratung.
**Was uns wichtig ist**
Erfolgreicher Verkauf beginnt mit Vertrauen. Deshalb erwarten wir eine ehrliche Beratung, nachvollziehbare Aussagen und einen respektvollen Umgang mit Menschen.
Die Arbeit im Aussendienst verlangt Einsatz: Du sprichst täglich neue Menschen an, erlebst auch Ablehnung und musst immer wieder selbst aktiv werden. Wer Freude daran hat, aus Erfahrungen zu lernen und konsequent dranzubleiben, findet bei uns eine Aufgabe mit Verantwortung und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
**Wir suchen Menschen, die sich bewusst für diesen Beruf entscheiden und sich langfristig etwas aufbauen möchten.**
**Bereit für deinen nächsten Schritt?**
Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.
Erzähl uns, was dich am Aussendienst reizt und weshalb du Teil von Volmera werden möchtest.
**Bring deine Persönlichkeit mit – und entwickle mit uns deine Stärke im Verkauf.**
